verses.text: My son, hold on to my words. Store my commands deep inside you.
Follow my commands and live! Protect what I teach you like you'd protect your own eyes.
Tie these words around your fingers. Carve them into your heart.
Tell wisdom, “You're my sister.” Treat understanding like family.
They'll keep you away from the woman who lures you in, the outsider with the smooth talk.
I was at my window, looking out through the lattice.
I saw some kids who didn't know better. One young guy in the group had no sense at all.
He walked down the street by her corner and took the road to her house.
The day was fading into evening, and the night closed in dark around him.
Then a woman came out to meet him, dressed like a prostitute and ready to play him.
She's loud and defiant. She can never stay home.
One minute she's in the street, the next she's in the square, lurking at every corner.
She grabbed him and kissed him, then looked him right in the face and said,
“I've got meat from my peace offerings. I kept my vows today.
That's why I came out to meet you. I've been looking everywhere for you, and here you are.
I've dressed my couch with woven covers, striped cloth made from Egyptian yarn.
I've scented my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.
Come on, let's get our fill of love till morning. Let's lose ourselves in each other.
My husband's away from home. He's gone on a long trip.
He took a bag of money with him. He won't be back till the moon is full.”
She talked him right off course. She reeled him in with all that flattery.
He followed her on the spot, like an ox walking into the slaughterhouse, like a fool stepping into a noose,
till an arrow pierces his liver. He's like a bird rushing into a trap with no idea it's about to cost him his life.
So now, sons, listen to me. Pay attention to what I'm telling you.
Don't let your heart turn down her road. Don't wander onto her paths.
She's brought down a lot of people and left them wounded. The people she's killed could fill an army.
Her house is a road to the grave, heading down into the rooms of death.
